verdict.rationale: The evidence names two maintained integrations. Anrok's Stripe integration manages tax across Stripe billing cycles (docs-34), and Shopify is supported, with Anrok recalculating Shopify Tax's results (docs-19). The docs also refer to transactions sent by 'your billing system or integration' (docs-32) and to mapping billing-system products (docs-13), and a community comment notes enterprise sellers need Chargebee, NetSuite and similar systems (comm-1), but it does not confirm Anrok connects to them. Missing for 10: a documented integration catalog covering billing systems (e.g., Chargebee, NetSuite), several payment processors beyond Stripe, and commerce platforms beyond Shopify; detail on what the integrations sync and how they are maintained; independent hands-on corroboration.
